_comment: Destination titles adjudicated as NOT mappable to a single O*NET SOC, and titles whose proposed mapping was killed in adversarial review. Read by scripts/destination-profiles.py: `nextbatch` skips refused titles and the programs they hold (a program clears only when EVERY title maps, so a program carrying a refused title cannot clear and its other titles are not live work). Full reasoning per title: docs/tasks/dfva-crosswalk-backfill.SKILL.md. Use `nextbatch N --all` to see the raw queue.

refused.why: The Art History major's scope does not change the work: front-of-house invigilation at NGV/NGA is the same job whatever the attendant studied, and it still splits 33-9032 Security Guards (54.29) / 39-3031 Ushers and Lobby Attendants (57.83) / 39-7011 Tour Guides (72.11, the 'Visitor Services Officer' precedent) — 17.82 spread with no O*NET title anchor. refused.why: The BA scope removes the lab-science cells (19-1029 87.67, 19-4021 70.78) but the pooled record reporting it (Art History, gallery employers, skills Art Curatorship/Collection Management) still splits between a curatorial/provenance researcher 25-4012 Curators (81.15) and a social-science/humanities researcher 19-4061 (92.30, the sibling 'Research Assistant' cell) / 19-3093 (89.78) / 19-3099 (95.24) — 14.09 spread, no tiebreak. The global 'Senior Researcher' precedent is a family-mean imputation the script cannot reproduce.

refused.why: The Art History scope fixes the domain but not the dealer-vs-curator axis: art advisory is a sales role (41-3099 94.63 / 41-4012 83.19) as often as a curatorial one (25-4012 81.15), 13.48 spread, and the record's public-gallery employers (NGV, NGA, Museums Victoria) do not employ art consultants, so the record cannot say which side this graduate sits on.

refused.title: Justice Officer
refused.why: 'Justice' names a department (DJCS / Court Services Victoria), not an occupation, and the title is used for court-registry/fines administration, community corrections and custodial roles. Plausible SOCs spread 48.92 points — 43-4031 Court, Municipal, and License Clerks (91.38), 21-1092 Probation Officers (76.16), 33-3012 Correctional Officers (42.46) — with no precedent row or record-level tiebreak (Criminology record employers span courts, DJCS and legal services). A wrong row would silently move b-arts by a large amount.

refused.title: Dancer or Choreographer
refused.why: ANZSCO 211112 is a single occupation name covering two distinct Felten occupations, 27-2031 Dancers (0.01) and 27-2032 Choreographers (26.07), a 26.06-point spread with no tiebreak in the occupation definition ('performs dances, and creates and arranges dance'). Picking either side systematically moves b-fadance/mc-dnce by up to 26 points; a midpoint is not a row the script can compute. Leave unmapped until the JSA source can be split by component, or a program-scoped decision is taken.

refused.title: Music Professionals nec
refused.why: ANZSCO 211299 is the residual of 2112 Music Professionals, whose SOC twins are 27-2041 Music Directors and Composers (84.63) and 27-2042 Musicians and Singers (63.51): a 21.12-point spread, and the residual's members (arrangers, copyists, conductors, music therapists where JSA codes them here for rehab-therapy graduates) fall on both sides with no tiebreak. It blocks four programs (mc-clinrhb, mc-musop, mc-musorp, mc-muspt) across performance and therapy, so a single row cannot be disambiguated by program context.

refused.title: Local Government Legislator
refused.why: SOC 11-1031 Legislators is absent from the 774 Felten occupations, so no cell exists for the work of legislating. The nearest surviving cells, 11-1011 Chief Executives (95.38) and 11-1021 General and Operations Managers (77.30), spread 18.08 points and neither describes an elected councillor. The item also arrives under ASCED 090513 Counselling, which is an implausible field pairing and suggests source noise; not mapped.

refused.title: Commissioned Defence Force Officer
refused.why: ANZSCO 139111 is a military commission (Major Group 1, Defence Force Senior Officers/unit group 1391). SOC 2010's military family (55-xxxx) is absent from the 774 Felten occupations, so no SOC exists for the work. Civilian analogues spread too far with no tiebreak: 11-1021 General and Operations Managers (77.30), 11-9199 Managers, All Other (86.58), 17-2011 Aerospace Engineers (95.49) for the engineering fields, 29-1069 Physicians (80.48) for the medicine field, 33-1012 First-Line Supervisors of Police (59.02) as the nearest uniformed-command code: a 36-point spread driven by which field list the graduate came from, which the title does not carry. Leave unmapped.

refused.title: Brewery Worker
refused.why: ANZSCO 831112 covers routine malting, mashing, fermenting, filtering and bottling tasks, and SOC splits that work across 51-3092 Food Batchmakers (54.57), 51-9011 Chemical Equipment Operators and Tenders (51.42), 51-9012 Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Operators (41.26) and 51-9111 Packaging and Filling Machine Operators (40.29) — a 14.28-point spread with no tiebreak: the beverage reading pulls to 51-3092, the process-plant reading to 51-9012, and no precedent or reported-title anchor can be checked without browsing. No 'All Other' home exists for the whole job.

refused.title: Building Associate
refused.why: ANZSCO 312112 provides technical support on building projects spanning construction supervision, inspection and cost estimating, and the plausible SOCs spread 25.76 points: 13-1051 Cost Estimators (96.18), 11-9021 Construction Managers (88.12), 17-3022 Civil Engineering Technicians (85.81) and 47-4011 Construction and Building Inspectors (70.42). The definition names all three functions without weighting one, so there is no tiebreak; a row would pick the index rather than the work.

refused.title: Special Education Teachers nec
refused.why: Reviewer refused proposed 25-2059. Refused. The Felten 25-2059 cell (47.80) is an artefact: the only O*NET detailed occupation under 25-2059 is 25-2059.01 Adapted Physical Education Specialists, so its AIOE describes adapted PE, not the classroom teaching that ANZSCO 241599 (teachers of the gifted, remedial and other special-needs teachers) actually does. Every genuine special-education teaching cell sits 33-47 points higher (25-2052 Elementary 81.13, 25-2054 Secondary 86.44, 25-2053 Middle 94.48) and the residual carries no level to choose among them, so the plausible SOCs spread 13.35 points (81.13 to 94.48) with no tiebreak and the nec rule's designated home is indefensible. Leave unmapped; the mapper's own flag on the row asked for exactly this call. Check output: 28 rows OK after removal (see scratchpad/global3b.kept.json).

refused.title: University Lecturer
refused.why: field-scoped refusals only; see unresolved_scopes

unresolved_scopes.why: Food Science and Biotechnology is two disciplines in one code: food science sits in 25-1041 Agricultural Sciences Teachers (81.58, the ag/food-science department cell) and biotechnology in 25-1042 Biological Science Teachers (92.85), 11.27 apart with no way to weight the halves.

Teacher Education: Higher Education's field list is clinicians-turned-educators (Anaesthetist, GP, Nurse Educator, Veterinarian) who lecture in their own discipline, so the discipline is not fixed by the field: 25-1072 Nursing (75.92), 25-1071 Health Specialties (85.63) and 25-1081 Education (92.02) spread 16.10. The existing mc-clined program-scoped row already covers the one cohort where the record fixes it; do not generalise it to the field.
